ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) central pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral and midline pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity light grey field across both lobes; low-intensity black borders along the entire trailing edge and a dark vertical pigment column extending from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch apex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the medial and lateral trailing edges; edge presents as a jagged black line with peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels in relative height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edge (partially visible) and sharp concave upward sweep along the trailing edge, terminating in acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular dark spots on the upper-left lobe; multiple faint circular ring-like outlines visible on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical dark linear markings on the mid-left lobe surface; several faint horizontal scratches on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular, high-contrast dark mass clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray and droplets creating transient high-intensity specular highlights across the central ventral surface.
